competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a replay selection policy.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include the simulator config, seed band and baseline run.
Report retention per replay token and class coverage with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: oversampling easy recent examples.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of replay sampling.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report retention per replay token and class coverage against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for oversampling easy recent examples; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
